# The `snes-stress` ES-DE fixture

A placeholder of I3 step 0a, which settles the folder; I3 step 1c builds the fixture, its `files.json` payloads and
this README's layout and counts, which tests assert.

The room the I3 budgets are measured on (docs/roadmap.md, I3, "Budgets") and the room of G02s: one cartridge system
whose full name is invented, 2,000 invented titles with generated covers, 300 of them with a duplicate release (another
region or revision), materialized within 10 s in Release. Nothing commercial: no real title, system name or cover.
Covers are generated when the fixture is materialized, never committed.
